title: More text paths can be cached
summary:
A text-cache tune-up fixes oversized metadata, narrows path exclusions, and makes HEAD requests reuse GET cache entries.

Cache exclusions now apply only to the exact model and feed paths, so other paths with similar prefixes remain cacheable.

HEAD requests now use the corresponding GET cache key and return headers without a response body.

Text-cache entries now store less metadata, addressing failures caused by metadata-size limits. Timing and size diagnostics were added to help trace cache behavior.
